# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large concatenation of real phone recordings from Crayon Roofing and Structures (factory base: Manali, Andarkuppam check-post, Chennai). The vast majority of calls are **not clean sales pitches** — they are a mix of:
- Genuine inbound sales enquiries (rate requests, size/quantity confirmation, order placing, dispatch follow-up)
- Dealer/distributor negotiation calls (screw and welding-rod schemes, bulk pricing, "dealer price" vs "consumer price")
- A large volume of internal/ops chatter (Diwali gift distribution to dealers, vehicle/loading logistics, bill-copy/outstanding follow-ups) which has been excluded per instructions.

After filtering, there is a **meaningful but noisy set of real sales conversations** — mostly short, transactional calls where a field/telecaller reads out rate + GST, confirms thickness/length/quantity, and pushes the customer to WhatsApp requirements for a quotation. Very few calls show a full consultative sales conversation (the "Meetech Design" cutter/L-flash call and the "puff panel" wall-cladding enquiry are the most detailed). Most interactions are rate-quote-and-disengage; closing language is thin. This KB is built strictly from what is actually said — thickness/rate numbers, objections, and phrasing are real quotes, glossed in English.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon Roofing is a **metal roofing sheet manufacturer/fabricator** (not a general steel trader), running coil-fed roll-forming lines at its Manali/Andarkuppam factory, with a separate factory for PUFF/tile-profile panels. Confirmed product lines from calls:

**1. Color-coated metal roofing sheets (core product)**
- Brands quoted: **JSW Color On Plus**, **JSW Pragati/Pragathi**, **JSW Radiance**, **JSW Silver On**, **Asian Indradhanush**, **Asian Force**
- Thickness range mentioned: 0.45 mm, 0.47 mm, 0.50 mm, 0.6 mm (0.7 mm explicitly **not** stocked — "0.7 mm-ல இல்ல, 0.6 mm-ல sky blue available")
- Colors: Sky Blue, Off-White/Half White, Royal Blue, Grey/Dark Green ("Kali Shelt Green"), Terracotta
- Profile types: trapezoidal/standard profile ("color வர மாதிரி trapezoidal profile type-ல இருக்கும்"), tile-profile sheets (made at a separate factory, run by partner fabricators like Amar/Everlast for some customers)

**2. Accessories/fabrication (custom cut-to-order)**
- L-flash, ridge, gutter, crimp sheets, cutter pieces — built to customer diagram with standard widths (e.g., ridge/L-flash standard width 16 mm reference, cutter standard width "610 mm")
- Bend sheets (e.g., "21 feet + 9 inch bend")

**3. PUFF insulated panels** (wall + roof)
- 50 mm thickness common ask; separate factory
- Positioned for cold-storage/industrial roof+wall cladding ("wall panel-உம் roof-உம்")

**4. Polycarbonate sheets**
- Thickness stocked: 1.5 mm, 1.8 mm, 2 mm (10 mm occasionally quoted for different use)
- Standard max length: **15 feet** ("polycarbonate-ஐ பொறுத்தவரைக்கும் 15 அடி தான் standard")
- Brand reference: Lexan

**5. Screws & fasteners**
- Tata Agri-Go self-drilling/self-tapping screws — sizes 1 inch, 2 inch, M8x55mm, 65mm, rust-free variants
- Sold in cartons/boxes (small box = 200 pcs)

**6. Welding rods**
- Tata and a budget brand "Rasi" discussed; dealer schemes pushed monthly with slab targets (60/100/300 packets)

**7. Items explicitly NOT made/stocked** (useful for objection handling):
- UPVC sheets ("UPVC நம்மகிட்ட available இல்லை")
- Liner sheets ("liner நம்ம இதுல பண்ணவே இல்லையே")
- MS corrugated sheet in customer's exact spec — redirected to standard metal roofing
- GI sheet in 80/120 GSM spangle grade — team had to check internally

**Payment & delivery terms (explicitly stated):**
- Standard: **50% advance, 50% before/at delivery** — "50% advance payment, balance 50% வந்து delivery-க்கு முன்னாடி payment பண்ணனும் sir."
- "Vehicle/transport is customer's scope" — repeated consistently: "vehicle உங்க scope தான் வரும்."
- No cash-bill without GST: "without GST பண்ண முடியாது... with GST தான் full-ஆவே."
- Polycarbonate/custom jobs: "price is valid today/tomorrow only" (urgency close used once).
